faq.q: Which municipalities does this page cover?
faq.a: Four: Surrey, Langley, Abbotsford and Delta — each of which plans through its own Official Community Plan and zoning bylaw; there is no single shared land use plan document for the four.

faq.q: What is an Official Community Plan?
faq.a: In Delta's own description — the example here — an OCP describes where and what type of housing can be added across the city and contains long-term objectives and policies that guide decisions about land use, development, services, amenities and infrastructure.

faq.q: What is Delta's current land use plan?
faq.a: The Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400, 2024, adopted July 8, 2024, is a single consolidated plan with the Land Use Plan at s. 1.5 and designations at s. 1.5.1 on Map 2. It has no community area-plan schedules.

faq.q: How do I check zoning and future land use for an Abbotsford property?
faq.a: The City of Abbotsford's Development Planning pages direct property checks to the City's property information search or a property search in WebMap for current zoning, future land uses and development permit areas.

faq.q: Does an OCP designation settle what I can build?
faq.a: No. In the Delta model, the OCP designation is the first of three layers — designation (s. 1.5.1 / Map 2), then the parcel's zone under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, then any Development Permit Area — and on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission's rules apply on top of all three.
